pipe.busy: Tunnel mode is in use by another Windows user on this PC.
pipe.busySelf: The app's previous connection to the service is still closing. Try again in a few seconds.
pipe.version: The app and the Tunnel mode service are of incompatible versions. Update the app.
pipe.helloFirst: The Tunnel mode service expected a greeting first.
pipe.badRequest: The Tunnel mode service did not understand the request. Update the app.
pipe.unavailable: The Tunnel mode service is not running.
pipe.denied: The Tunnel mode service is not available to this Windows account.
pipe.noAnswer: The Tunnel mode service is not answering. Try again in a few seconds.
pipe.lost: The connection to the Tunnel mode service was lost.
pipe.badReply: The app did not understand the Tunnel mode service. Update the app.
pipe.tooLarge: The request is too large for the Tunnel mode service.
pipe.notOurs: The program answering for the Tunnel mode service is not the installed service.

refused.text: {{field}} contains characters that are not allowed.
refused.localProxy: The local proxy must run on this computer (127.0.0.1).

folder.untrusted: Ordinary users can change the service's files, so it does not start the tunnel. Reinstall the service.
folder.fileMissing: A file of the Tunnel mode service is missing: {{file}}. Reinstall the service.

install.notElevated: Installing the service needs administrator rights.
install.fileMismatch: {{file}} differs from the file shipped with the app.
install.imageChanged: The program file changed during installation. Run the installation again.
install.failed: The Tunnel mode service could not be installed.
install.notRestarted: The helper service could not be updated and is stopped. Windows starts it again the next time the PC starts.

uninstall.filtersKept: The helper service stays for now: it removes its network filters later. Everything else is removed.
